posts.title: notes on the moment [02 nov 2026]
posts.description: introductions: Hello from an undisclosed location very far outside of the United States. I write because we are, at this moment, experiencing a reprise of the Cuban Missile Crisis, with a days-long fermata. The Trump Administration, presiding over the modern-day United States of America, openly debates nuclear activity
